central_question: When does individual reproductive selection align with or oppose unconditional finite-population persistence, and can maternal outcross, paternal outcross and viable-self gene transmission predict the boundary before trajectories are observed?
scientific_program: Predict alignment/discordance using a pre-outcome F/P/S decomposition, then falsify with independent finite-population evolutionary trajectories.

existing_evidence_not_reclassified.meaning: four-setting evolutionary non-necessity and attenuation result; original manuscript unchanged
exploratory exact finite-genetic self/father/mother transmission accounting, nonuniversal direction reversal
assigned expression-order capacity sensitivity; one supported registered K effect
synthetic one-step and 80-generation engineering bridge, zero independent ecological histories

separate_estimands.individual_selection_beta: d log(0.5*F_mutant+0.5*P_mutant+S_mutant)/dz_mutant at fixed resident pollen and competition; rare-mutant invasion gradient
separate_estimands.group_seed_gamma: d log E[total viable outcross offspring + total viable self offspring]/dz under simultaneous group trait-expression shift
separate_estimands.group_persistence_gamma: d P(N_H>0 | do(group trait expression shift), specified subsequent evolution policy)/dz; denominator ALL admitted populations including extinctions
separate_estimands.evolutionary_persistence_contrast: P(N_H>0 | allow specified trait evolution)-P(N_H>0 | matched freeze specified trait evolution), paired over previously unexposed independent visitor histories
separate_estimands.independent_units: visitor ecological histories; demographic, transplant-resampling and recruitment repeats nested

competing_predictions: higher discordance frequency where male siring shares change without increasing total viable group outcross output, versus seed-increment-matched controls
higher discordance frequency where prior selfing displaces viable outcrossed seeds after depression/cost accounting, versus unfilled-ovule delayed-self controls
changes of beta versus Gamma_seed and Gamma_persist signs across visitor supply, capacity, depression, mating costs and pollen discounting are outcome-neutral until assessed
strong evolutionary-suicide interpretation requires both individual-favored trait evolution and lower survival under a matched blocked-evolution counterfactual

time20_transplant.conditioning: 21/24 surviving in both capacity arms at one earlier exposed synthetic budget does not imply common survivor identities; collect intersections and complete denominators
time20_transplant.endpoint: unconditional survival from t20 to t80 among all admitted transplant recipients
time20_transplant.genetic_source_effect: average of G48−G8 contrasts at target K8 and target K48
time20_transplant.recipient_capacity_effect: average of K48−K8 contrasts under donor G8 and donor G48
time20_transplant.interaction: separately report GxK difference-in-differences; never add it to both averaged main effects
time20_transplant.further_identification: initial census N0 must be independently factorialized to separate starting N from later K regulation
time20_transplant.caveat: post-survival donor selection and ongoing genetic drift prevent simple labels of isolated historical genetics or pure demographic causality

exclusions: no genetic load, deleterious mutation accumulation or purging in zero-mutation fixed-depression Model3
not equivalent to assigned A-first vs I-first persistence interaction
do not reuse exposed confirmatory or synthetic visitor histories
